## 1. The handover

<!-- What did you receive, from whom, and what does the README say? -->

```{r}
#| label: read-raw
batches_raw <- read_excel(file.path(raw_dir, "campaign2_batches.xlsx"), skip = 3)
lab_raw <- read_delim(file.path(raw_dir, "campaign2_lab.csv"), delim = ";",
                      locale = locale(encoding = "latin1"),
                      col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))
lots_raw <- fromJSON(file.path(raw_dir, "campaign2_lots.json"))
suppliers <- read_csv(file.path(raw_dir, "suppliers.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

glimpse(batches_raw)
glimpse(lab_raw)
str(lots_raw)
```

## 5. Validation

```{r}
#| label: validate
#| eval: false
rules <- validator(
  yield_ok = yield_pct >= 0 & yield_pct <= 100
  # more rules ...
)
summary(confront(batches, rules))

# Every foreign key must have a match: these should all return zero rows
anti_join(batches, lots, by = "lot_id")
anti_join(lab, batches, by = "batch_id")

stopifnot(
  "one row per batch" = !anyDuplicated(batches$batch_id)
  # more assertions ...
)
```

## 7. Building the database

```{r}
#| label: build-db
#| eval: false
db_path <- "data/campaign2.sqlite"
if (file.exists(db_path)) file.remove(db_path)   # always rebuild from scratch
con <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), db_path)
dbExecute(con, "PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")

dbExecute(con, "
  CREATE TABLE suppliers (
    supplier_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    name        TEXT NOT NULL,
    country     TEXT
  )")
# CREATE TABLE lots, batches and lab_results here, with their keys and constraints.

dbAppendTable(con, "suppliers", suppliers)
# Append the other tables, parents before children.

dbDisconnect(con)
```

## 8. Does it work?

```{r}
#| label: queries
#| eval: false
con <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "data/campaign2.sqlite")
dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM batches")
# Your queries: results per analyte, the wettest lot and supplier,
# yield and purity by catalyst, the batches with comments ...
dbDisconnect(con)
```
